title: Poor Quality for the Price
text:
Poor Quality for the Price. My past experiences with Mikasa products have been positive so I was expecting these to be good as well. Unfortunately, these fall very short, especially considering the price.

I received these packed in three nested boxes - a box inside a box inside a box, with appropriate padding to protect them. When I took them out of the box, two of the three were bent, like they has been dropped and hit on the handles before they were boxed up since the boxes in which they were packed were pristine.

I was able to bend them back into shape by hand which presents another complaint - these are very lightweight and flimsy. I've worked with galvanized steel buckets on a farm and those were darn near indestructible; these trays are much less sturdy and the fact that I can bend them up by hand without any real effort leaves questions about material. And, these certainly are not up to the same standard of other Mikasa products I have used in the past. At the price point I would expect solid, heavier trays that are not easily bent; instead, these compete with the quality of items you'd find at the local large discount department store.

I am very disappointed in these and cannot recommend them. They're functional and they're attractive, but they're poorly made.
